decision.rationale:
WHAT I DID
One free transfer: Calafiori out, Gabriel in (both Arsenal). Haaland is captain and Mbeumo is vice. No hit. I did not play the Triple Captain the solver planned for this week. That call is yours, and the reasons are below.

WHAT I LEARNED
- Calafiori: dropped for Arsenal v Everton (Lewis-Skelly started at left-back). He came off the bench and picked up what Arteta called a "slight issue" late on. He's a doubt for the cup tie on Tuesday and for Liverpool on Sunday. I cut his minutes from 56 to 25.
- Gabriel: had a knee scare against Everton but played on and scored. I set him at 88 minutes.
- Konsa: scored against Everton and is a regular starter. 88 minutes.
- Thomas (Coventry): went off in the 59th minute against Fulham with a lower-leg problem and was iced below the knee. Lampard couldn't say how bad it is. I cut him from 63 to 40 minutes.
- João Pedro: hurt in training on 23 Oct and missed the Spurs game. Alonso says there is a lot of swelling and no return date. I cut him from 38 to 10 minutes. He's on the bench anyway.
- Guéhi: started at Villa but was reportedly taken off at half-time after errors. Maresca says his form doesn't worry him, but Maresca has also named him as due a rest. I cut him from 81 to 72 minutes.
- Tavernier: scored in the 3-0 win at Old Trafford on 25 Oct. Regular starter, 85 minutes.
- Haaland: limped off in GW7 and sat out the AEK game. He then started at Villa on 24 Oct and scored. Maresca keeps saying Haaland needs rest "at some point". City host Brighton twice this week, in the Carabao Cup midweek and then in the league in GW9. I set him at 85 minutes.
- Not checked: Leeds, Brighton, Brentford, Man Utd and Hull, because my search budget ran out. I found no news on Muharemović, Calvert-Lewin, Vuskovic, Groß, Verbruggen, Lewis-Potter, Mbeumo or Tzolakis, so they stay on the model's numbers.

WHY THIS PLAN
- Calafiori is injured and has just lost his place. Gabriel is a regular starter and is scoring. That's a football reason for the move, not just a solver margin. After my changes the transfer is worth +1.8 over rolling (plan 6).
- Plan 5 adds Konsa for a 4-point hit and comes out only +0.2. That's noise. I'd rather wait for news on Thomas and keep the transfer for next week, which the solver plans to do anyway.
- Plan 7 (two hits) is worse on net.

On the chip: the panel puts Triple Captain at +5.7 this week, against a bar of 4.2. Its next best week is GW15 at +5.1, so the gain from playing it now is small. Last week's review said not to play it until Haaland's minutes are confirmed, and they aren't. He has just come back from a knock, his manager keeps talking about resting him, and City play Brighton twice in four days. It isn't the chip's last week, since the first set runs to GW19. If Haaland starts the Carabao game, or Maresca confirms him for Saturday at Friday's press conference, you could play it before the deadline (Sat 11:00). Otherwise keep it for GW15.

Prices: Gabriel is being bought (about 107k net in) and may be slightly cheaper tonight than at the deadline.

Mbeumo is vice-captain, with 4.92 at Chelsea.
